description: Free check of how ready a website is for AI assistants and AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude): whether their crawlers get in (robots.txt, firewalls), whether the content is readable without JavaScript, structured data, llms.txt and the signals models use to cite a source. Takes about 10-30 seconds. Returns the grade (A-F), the score and the list of problems, without fixes. The full report with step-by-step fixes and a PDF is sent by JustIdea Agency to the user's e-mail. Use only details the user gave you: never invent or guess an e-mail address. Before calling, tell the user the report goes to their e-mail and ask for consent under the privacy policy (https://justidea.agency/en/privacy-policy/); set zgoda to true only after they agree. At most 2 scans per e-mail address per day. If it returns status "running", call get_scan_result with the scan_id after 30-60 seconds.

email.description: The user's own e-mail address. The full report with fixes is sent there, and only there.

language.description: Report language. Use "pl" for Polish-speaking users, "en" for everyone else.

name.description: Optional. The user's first name, only if they gave it.

phone.description: Optional. The user's phone number, only if they gave it and want a call about the results.

url.description: The website to scan: a domain or URL, e.g. "mystore.com". Only the home domain is used.

zgoda.description: Must be true: the user agreed to receive the report by e-mail, to be contacted by JustIdea about the results, and to the processing of this data under the privacy policy.

name: scan_ai_visibility
title: Free AI visibility scan
